description: This Java source file defines the class SudoRetrieveNamespaceReportResponse, which is a response type for a specific command in the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for creating instances from JSON, accessing the contained SearchNamespaceReportResult, and handling JSON serialization/deserialization. It is part of a package related to thing search commands, specifically in a sudo context.
